connections.subtitle: Import links, config files, QR codes or subscriptions. Secrets are stored encrypted.
connections.empty: No servers yet. Paste a link (vless://, vmess://, trojan://, ss://, hy2://, tuic://, socks5://) or open a WireGuard / AmneziaWG / OpenVPN file.

import.title: Add servers
import.qr.none: No QR code found in that image.

import.sub.invalid: That does not look like a subscription URL.
subs.title: Subscriptions
subs.hint: BYDLO downloads the list only when you add or refresh it.
subs.name: Name (optional)
tools.subtitle: Standalone helpers that run next to (or without) your VPN.
tools.zapret.desc: Flowseal zapret-discord-youtube: DPI bypass with ready-made strategies.
tools.zapret.missing: Zapret is not installed. Download the pinned Flowseal release or choose an extracted release folder.
tools.zapret.platform: Zapret is available on Windows in this version. Linux / macOS support is planned.
tools.zapret.tcpts: Flowseal recommends enabling TCP timestamps (netsh interface tcp set global timestamps=enabled). BYDLO does not change this system setting for you.
tools.tg.desc: Flowseal tg-ws-proxy: local MTProto proxy for Telegram Desktop over WebSocket.
tools.tg.dcip.hint: One DC:IP per line. If photos or videos do not load, keep only 4:149.154.167.220 or clear the list (upstream advice).
tools.tg.cf: Cloudflare fallback when WebSocket is unavailable
tools.tg.runtime.hint: BYDLO installs the pinned tg-ws-proxy package into a private Python environment (needs Python 3.9+). Or point to an existing tg-ws-proxy executable.
tools.tg.notelegram: Telegram did not open. Copy the link and send it to yourself in Telegram.
tools.tg.secret.restart: New secret generated. Restart TgWsProxy and update Telegram.
tools.engines.hint: BYDLO downloads pinned versions and verifies their SHA-256. WireGuard, AmneziaWG and OpenVPN use their official installed clients.
routing.subtitle: Split tunneling, DNS and rules. Applied on the next connect.
routing.mesh.hint: Leaves 100.64.0.0/10 and fd7a:115c:a1e3::/48 outside the tunnel so other VPN / mesh-network clients keep working.
routing.private.hint: Home router, printers and LAN stay direct.
routing.only.hint: Everything else goes direct (split tunneling, include mode).
routing.process.hint: Process names, e.g. game.exe. Only works in TUN mode.
stats.subtitle: Live speed, totals and the event log.
stats.nostats: This engine does not report live traffic yet.
settings.autoreconnect.hint: Up to 3 attempts if the engine stops unexpectedly.
settings.advanced.hint: Ports, system proxy, Mock Mode and diagnostics.
settings.port.hint: SOCKS5 + HTTP on 127.0.0.1 (Xray uses the next port for HTTP).
settings.sysproxy.hint: Windows only. The previous proxy settings are restored on disconnect.
settings.mock.hint: Simulates connecting, traffic and errors. No engine is started and no traffic is carried. For UI testing only.
settings.mock.forced: Forced on by --mock / BYDLO_MOCK=1 for this session.
settings.admin.hint: Needed for TUN mode, WireGuard / AmneziaWG / OpenVPN tunnels and Zapret.
settings.safelock: Development safety lock is active (BYDLO_SAFE_DEV=1): real engines will refuse to start.
about.text: Free and open-source launcher for VPNs, proxies and censorship-bypass tools. BYDLO is a front-end: the real work is done by the projects below. Huge thanks to their authors.
orphans.text: Engines from a previous session are still running.
